latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release summarizing Jacobs Solutions’ evolution and business model.

- Covers company history, major acquisitions, and rebranding to Jacobs Solutions.
- Outlines business model: engineering consulting, project management, tech services, and government focus.
- Analyzes competitive advantages in federal contracts, complex project delivery, and technical expertise.
- Shares key financials: ~$16B revenue, 55,000 staff, large government contract share.
- Includes unique Jacobs project highlights in defense, aerospace, and semiconductor sectors.
